subject: Licence request: RSV Second Catholic Edition in a free Catholic Bible app (John 1:1)
body:
Dear Permissions Department,

North Boutique Studios Ltd. publishes John 1:1, a free Catholic Bible and prayer app for iPhone, iPad and Android. The National Council of Churches refers requests for the RSV Second Catholic Edition to Ignatius Press. We ask for a licence to include the complete RSV-2CE in the app.

- Use: the complete text in the app's reader, available offline, with search; daily Mass reading references and a verse-of-the-day widget open the same text. The text is not changed. The copyright notice appears in the reader and in Settings.
- Working title: John 1:1 – Catholic Bible. Not salable: the app is free; one optional in-app purchase unlocks a separate library of Church Fathers, not the Bible.
- Formats and markets: iOS and Android apps, worldwide, English, general adult audience.
- Anticipated launch: spring 2027, after the licence is granted.
- Audience to date: on iOS, 121 downloads in the last 90 days and about 330 existing users who updated; on Android, newly launched. We expect a few thousand downloads a year.
- Organisation: North Boutique Studios Ltd., 846 Roulston St, London, ON N6H 0E4, Canada; an Ontario for-profit corporation registered for GST/HST.

We would be grateful for your terms, including any royalty or fee and any requirements for storage and display.
